ns2:course.label: Space, Time, and Matter-ACP
ns2:course.description: Philosophical examination of some fundamental concepts and theories of the physical world, such as time, matter, causation, space, and geometry; interpretation of quantum theory. Graduate students write an additional paper. Same as PHIL 419. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit is not given for both PHYS 419 and PHYS 420. Prerequisite: Junior standing; one physical science course; one of PHYS 214, PHIL 101, PHIL 270, or PHIL 317; or consent of instructor.
